newsitem.title: USA: U.S. dlr strong for quite some time now - Rubin.
newsitem.headline: U.S. dlr strong for quite some time now - Rubin.

text.p: U.S. Treasury Secretary Robert Rubin reiterated on Monday U.S. support for a strong dollar.
"A strong dollar is in our nation's interest," he told a group of students. He explained that a strong dollar helps keep down inflation and interest rates.
"We have had a strong dollar for quite some time now," he added.
Rubin said that the Group of Seven believes that "the large assymetries" that had existed in foreign exchange rates have been corrected.
He noted that the dollar has appreciated substantially against both the Japanese yen and German mark over the past two years.
